name: Leslie H. Garcia
office: City of West Covina, Member of the City Council, 2nd District

items.text: Leslie H. Garcia is an air quality instrument specialist and a candidate for West Covina City Council District 2. She works at the South Coast Air Quality Management District. Her campaign says she previously worked at the California Air Resources Board on a statewide incentive program to reduce air pollution.

sentences.text: Leslie H. Garcia is an air quality instrument specialist and a candidate for West Covina City Council District 2.
She works at the South Coast Air Quality Management District.
Her campaign says she previously worked at the California Air Resources Board on a statewide incentive program to reduce air pollution.

items.text: Her campaign supports a pathway to permanently ban data centers and end the city’s Flock surveillance contract. At a September 2026 council meeting she supported the city’s resolution opposing large-scale data centers and battery storage and said the ban should be permanent. Her platform also includes renter protections and investments in parks and youth recreation.
